faq.name: pricing-faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Pricing FAQ — Common Questions About Our Plans
faq.description: Everything you need to know about credits, plans, refunds, and what each tier unlocks.

items.title: Quale piano dovrei scegliere?
items.description: Per una decisione mirata (es. Lisbona vs Barcellona), scegli Standard a $9.9. Per ricerca multi-città con cronologia permanente e analisi linee più approfondita, scegli Professional a $19.9. Per un piano di trasferimento completo con più candidati, Research Pass a $29.9 sblocca timing 90 giorni permanente e fino a 5 progetti. Se date e shortlist cambiano ancora, Plus Monthly a $7.9 è l'opzione flessibile.

items.title: Come si consumano i crediti?
items.description: Consumo: 1 chat AI = 10 crediti; 1 report completo di confronto città = 50 crediti. Scegli in base alla profondità — Standard basta per un primo ciclo; Professional e Research Pass aggiungono quota maggiore più cronologia, linee avanzate e timing 90 giorni. Confronta i piani per capacità, non per stime sul numero di chat.

items.title: Come si consumano i crediti?

Confronta i piani per capacità, non per stime sul numero di chat.

items.title: Qual è la differenza tra Standard e Professional?
items.description: Standard ($9.9, 150 crediti) è per una decisione focalizzata. Professional ($19.9, 500 crediti) aggiunge più quota e capacità esclusive: (1) ⭐ cronologia chat permanente; (2) ⭐ analisi avanzata delle linee planetarie incl. Chiron, Lilith e punti medi; (3) ⭐ risultati timing 30 giorni completi. Una decisione → Standard. Revisione continua o lavoro più approfondito → Professional.

items.title: Plus Monthly vs Plus Yearly — which should I pick?
items.description: Plus Monthly ($7.9/mo) is best if you want to try Plus through one real move or trip with no long-term commitment. Plus Yearly ($71/yr, about $5.92/mo) saves you ~34% and is best if you know you'll be researching for the full year. Both give 150 credits/month, full 30-day timing, and 90-day timing while active. Cancel anytime.

items.title: What happens to my research projects if I cancel Plus?
items.description: Your saved projects and shortlist are kept in your account. However, after cancellation: 90-day timing windows become read-only, monthly credit refresh stops, and you fall back to the entitlements of your last one-time purchase (if any). Standard users keep their credits and 30-day timing preview. To get 90-day timing permanently, buy the Research Pass instead of subscribing.

items.title: Cosa include Research Pass in più rispetto a Professional?
items.description: Research Pass aggiunge a Professional: (1) ⭐ timing 90 giorni permanente; (2) ⭐ fino a 5 progetti salvati; (3) ⭐ export batch di più chat; (4) ⭐ supporto email prioritario (risposta in 24 ore). Include anche una quota di ricerca maggiore per una pianificazione seria del trasferimento.

items.title: What is your refund policy?
items.description: Standard and Professional one-time purchases qualify for a full change-of-mind refund within 7 days of payment with fewer than 3 completed paid AI uses (0–2). Each question-and-answer or paid report counts once, not each chat window. Research Pass: 7 days with fewer than 5 uses. First Plus payments, monthly or yearly when offered, have a 7-day guarantee with fewer than 5 uses. Billing errors, non-delivery and service problems are reviewed separately; mandatory rights are unaffected.

items.title: Can I pay with Alipay, WeChat Pay, or other local methods?
items.description: Yes. We support Stripe (international credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and Creem (Alipay, WeChat Pay for Chinese users). The payment method selector appears automatically when you check out — pick whichever works for your region. Prices may be slightly adjusted for CNY payments to account for currency conversion.
